scripts.title: SPYMM STA v8.3 [UPD] - BEST KEYLESS/OPEN SOURCE
scripts.features:
SPYMM v8.2 — Features
Game: Survive the Apocalypse | Menu: Right Shift

Some Features are not listed, im just lazy.
You will love it.

Visuals
- Mob ESP — Highlight + name/distance on all zombies (Runner, Brute, Boss, etc.)
- Player ESP — Highlight + name/health/distance + equipped tool on all players
- Structure ESP — Highlight + name/distance on all 18 placed structures
- Item ESP — 8 categories: Guns (red), Melee (orange), Medical (green), Armor (blue), Food (lime), Resources (cyan), Fuel (gold), Abilities (purple)
- Chams — See-through highlights for all ESP types
- Max Distance Slider — Global render cutoff for all ESPs

Player
- Inf Jump — Jump anywhere, even mid-air
- NoClip — Walk through walls, FE bypassed with anti-rubberband
- Auto Sprint — Holds sprint key permanently
- Bunny Hop — Auto-jumps while moving for momentum
- Funny Dance — Looping dance visible to all players (FE compatible, physics fallback if blocked)

Combat
- Kill Aura — AoE auto-attack on all mobs in range; configurable range, swing rate, priority, auto-equip, visual target indicator
- Aimbot — Camera-based aim at mobs/players; configurable FOV, range, smoothness, velocity prediction, aim part, FOV circle

Exploits
- Auto Pickup — Automatically collects nearby items (80+ items, configurable radius + whitelist)

Misc
- Anti-AFK — Prevents AFK kick (on by default)
- Fullbright — Removes darkness, restores on disable
- Remove Fog — Removes all fog, FE bypassed (server can't restore it while active)
- Server Hop — Joins a random different server
- Rejoin — Reconnects to the same server instance
- Remote Spy — Logs all RemoteEvent/RemoteFunction calls to console
- FPS Unlocker — Sets a custom FPS cap (30–360)

UI Settings
- Theme Manager, Save Manager (named configs + autoload)
- DPI scale, corner radius, notification side, custom cursor, rebindable menu key

I will never use any type of key system. Only free or paid.
